metadata.desc: An intelligent long-term memory plugin with hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector + graph), WebUI management, and dynamic lifecycle. Supports session/persona isolation, importance decay, and auto-cleanup.

bot_language.hint: Set the language for plugin command and status replies. zh=Chinese (default), en=English, ru=Russian.

access_control.hint: Limit who can use long-term memory and map identities to consistent names across platforms.

whitelist_enabled.hint: When enabled, only listed users, groups, or sessions can capture, summarize, recall, or use Agent memory tools. An empty list denies all memory operations.

allowed_ids.hint: Enter one user ID, platform:user ID, group ID, or full session ID per line. Commas and semicolons are also supported.

identity_aliases.hint: Enter one source=canonical name mapping per line. The source may be platform:user ID, user ID, or current username, for example telegram:12345=Alex.

provider_settings.hint: Configure the AI models used by the memory system

embedding_provider_id.hint: The Embedding model ID used to generate memory vectors. Leave blank to use AstrBot default. You can find existing Embedding Provider IDs in the AstrBot admin panel under 'LLM Configuration' (e.g., openai_embedding).

llm_provider_id.hint: The large language model ID used for summarizing conversations and evaluating memory importance. Leave blank to use AstrBot default. A model with strong reasoning capabilities is recommended.

session_manager.hint: Manage user session states and conversation history caching behavior

enable_full_group_capture.hint: Whether to capture all messages in group chats, including messages that do not mention the bot. When enabled, every group message is recorded to build richer group-chat context.

max_sessions.hint: Maximum number of sessions kept in memory (LRU eviction). Once exceeded, the least recently used session is removed from cache, but data remains in the database.

session_ttl.hint: Sessions inactive for longer than this duration are removed from cache. Default is 3600 (1 hour).

context_window_size.hint: Maximum number of historical messages passed to the LLM. Larger values provide richer context but consume more tokens. Recommended: 20-100.

max_messages_per_session.hint: Maximum number of historical messages retained per session in the database. When exceeded, only the oldest summarized messages are deleted to avoid losing unsummarized context.

cleanup_batch_size.hint: Minimum number of old summarized messages to delete per batch when the session history exceeds the limit. A value too small will cause only a few messages to be deleted each round after overflow.

recall_engine.hint: Control memory retrieval and injection into conversations

top_k.hint: Number of most relevant memories returned per retrieval. Set to 0 to skip automatic recall/injection while keeping historical injection cleanup. Recommended: 3-10.

max_k.hint: Maximum memories returned when the Agent actively calls the long-term memory retrieval tool. Used to limit single-tool recall scale. Recommended: 5-10.

importance_weight.hint: Weight coefficient for memory importance in the hybrid scoring. Higher values prioritize high-importance memories.

min_importance_for_retrieval.hint: Filter out memories below this importance value. Range: 0-1. Set to 0 to disable filtering.

min_similarity_for_retrieval.hint: Filter vector candidates below this similarity. Keyword-only matches remain eligible. Range: 0-1; 0 disables the filter.

recent_memory_count.hint: Reserve this many recall slots for recent memories in the current scope. Set to 0 to disable.

recent_memory_max_age_hours.hint: Only memories inside this age window qualify for reserved recent slots. Set to 0 for no age limit.

memory_type_filter.hint: Recall all memories, or exclude memories known to contain only preferences or relationships. Legacy untyped memories remain eligible.

fallback_to_vector.hint: Automatically fall back to pure vector search when hybrid retrieval fails or returns empty results. Recommended to keep enabled.

injection_method.hint: Where to inject memories into LLM requests. extra_user_content is recommended: append to the current user message without affecting prefix cache or polluting conversation history. user_message_before: inject as a user-message prefix. user_message_after: inject as a user-message suffix. fake_tool_call: inject as fake tool-call message pairs so the LLM understands them as retrieval results. fake_tool_call_deepseek_v4 is deprecated and automatically falls back to fake_tool_call. With Gemini, fake_tool_call automatically falls back to extra_user_content. system_prompt is deprecated and automatically falls back to extra_user_content.

auto_remove_injected.hint: Automatically remove previously injected memory fragments from history before injecting new ones, preventing duplicate accumulation and token waste. Recommended to keep enabled.

inject_with_recent_context.hint: When enabled, memory retrieval appends the recent two dialogue turns to the current query, improving relevance for follow-up questions and reducing unrelated recalls.

recent_context_max_age_seconds.hint: Only historical messages within this time range extend the recall query. Set to 0 to disable the time limit.

search_cache_enabled.hint: Reuse retrieval results for the same session and query within a short time window to reduce repeated SQLite and FAISS work during follow-up conversations.

search_cache_ttl_seconds.hint: How long retrieval cache entries are kept. Writes, updates, and deletes invalidate the cache automatically. Set to 0 to disable caching.

search_cache_max_size.hint: Maximum number of retrieval results kept in memory. When the limit is exceeded, the least recently used entries are evicted.

importance_decay.hint: Gradually reduce the importance of old memories over time to prevent outdated information from retaining high weight indefinitely

decay_rate.hint: The proportion of memory importance decayed per day. 0.01 means a 1% decrease daily. Set to 0 to disable decay.

access_decay_window_days.hint: Memories accessed within this window reduce their effective decay rate according to access count.

access_decay_max_count.hint: The access count that grants maximum decay protection. Additional accesses beyond this count do not increase protection further.

access_count_decay_multiplier.hint: After each daily decay pass, access counts are multiplied by this ratio so old hot memories do not stay protected forever.

protected_importance_threshold.hint: Memories at or above this importance do not participate in daily importance decay.

fusion_strategy.hint: Fusion parameters for BM25 and vector search results (internally uses the RRF algorithm)

rrf_k.hint: Lower values emphasize top-ranked results; higher values produce smoother fusion. Recommended: 30-120. Default is 60.

use_persona_filtering.hint: When enabled, only memories related to the current persona are recalled. Memories of different personas do not interfere with each other.

use_session_filtering.hint: Used only when Memory Scope Mode is Legacy. When enabled, each session is isolated; when disabled, memories are not filtered by session.

memory_scope_mode.hint: Legacy preserves existing settings; Per Session isolates each origin; Per User shares memory across chats for the same platform user; Global shares memory everywhere.

isolated_sessions.hint: Enter one full session ID per line. These sessions always use their own memory scope, overriding Per User, Global, and disabled legacy session filtering.

reflection_engine.hint: Control when conversation summarization is triggered and memories are generated

summary_trigger_rounds.hint: Trigger a summary and write it to memory after this many rounds of dialogue (one question and one answer counts as one round).

include_source_time_tags.hint: Derive source dates from original message timestamps and store them without relying on LLM inference.

source_retention_importance_threshold.hint: Store original messages separately when summary importance reaches this value, enabling verification, detailed Agent recall, and re-summarization. Range 0-1; 1 keeps only maximum-importance memories.

agent_tools.hint: Control whether AstrBot Agent receives tools for active long-term memory recall and writing.

enable_recall_tool.hint: When enabled, registers recall_long_term_memory so the Agent can actively search long-term memories.

enable_memorize_tool.hint: When enabled, registers memorize_long_term_memory so the Agent can actively write long-term memories.

graph_memory.hint: When enabled, both document-based and graph-based paths are maintained simultaneously, each supporting keyword and vector retrieval, with results unified into a single fused recall set.

enabled.hint: When enabled, graph nodes, edges, and graph vector indexes are automatically built. Recommended to keep enabled.

document_route_weight.hint: The proportion of the document path fusion score in the final dual-path ranking.

graph_route_weight.hint: The proportion of the graph path fusion score in the final dual-path ranking.

cross_route_bonus.hint: Extra score added when the same memory is hit by both the document path and the graph path.

expansion_limit.hint: Maximum number of candidate entries expanded from hit nodes to their neighbors during graph keyword retrieval.

expansion_hops.hint: Number of hops expanded outward from matched nodes during graph keyword retrieval. Default is 1; setting it to 2 can recall indirect relations with a small query-cost increase.

second_hop_weight.hint: Score weight for second-hop graph candidates. Higher values make indirect relations more likely to enter the final recall results.

dynamic_route_weighting.hint: Automatically adjust document-route and graph-route weights according to relationship, time, and definition-like intent in the query.

max_topics_per_memory.hint: Maximum number of topic nodes extracted from a single memory.

max_participants_per_memory.hint: Maximum number of participant nodes extracted from a single memory.

max_facts_per_memory.hint: Maximum number of key facts extracted from a single memory to enter the graph index.

atom_enabled.hint: When enabled, each key_fact becomes an independent memory atom with its own lifetime and decay curve. When disabled, the plugin falls back to the original coarse-grained behavior.

atom_maintenance_interval_hours.hint: How often the lifecycle manager runs expiration and forgetting checks for memory atoms.

atom_forget_delay_days.hint: How many days after expiration an atom is completely removed from retrieval indexes.

atom_purge_delay_days.hint: How many days after removal from retrieval indexes a forgotten atom is physically deleted from the database to reclaim storage.

migration_settings.hint: Control database version upgrade behavior on plugin startup

auto_migrate.hint: Automatically detect and upgrade outdated database versions on plugin startup. Recommended to keep enabled.

create_backup.hint: Automatically create a backup file before performing database migration to prevent data loss in case of migration failure. Recommended to keep enabled.

index_rebuild_settings.hint: Control batch size, Embedding request rate, and failure tolerance for the /lmem rebuild-index command. Low-spec cloud servers should keep concurrency small.

batch_size.hint: Number of memories read from the documents table per batch. Larger values increase memory peak and affect more entries on failure. Recommended: 25-100.

embedding_batch_size.hint: Number of texts included in a single Embedding API request. Reduce further if the provider has strict TPM rate limits.

tasks_limit.hint: Internal concurrency limit for batch Embedding. To avoid triggering API rate limits, the default is 1.

max_retries.hint: Maximum retry attempts for a failed Embedding batch.

retry_base_delay.hint: Base wait time for exponential backoff after a batch failure. At least 30 seconds will be waited when encountering 429/TPM rate limits.

batch_delay.hint: Additional wait time between each documents read batch, used to proactively reduce overall rebuild rate.

request_delay.hint: Wait time between each Embedding API sub-request. Increase this first if 429/TPM is triggered frequently.

max_failure_ratio.hint: During full vector rebuild, the new index will only be switched if the failure ratio does not exceed this value. 0.02 means up to 2% failure is allowed.

backup_settings.hint: Automatically back up the memory database daily to prevent accidental data loss

enabled.hint: Automatically back up the database after daily decay tasks. Recommended to keep enabled.

keep_days.hint: Backup files older than this number of days will be automatically deleted. Default is 7 days.

forgetting_agent.hint: Periodically clean up old memories that are both outdated and low importance to control memory store size

auto_cleanup_enabled.hint: Automatically clean up eligible old memories after daily importance decay.

auto_archived_enabled.hint: Move cleanup candidates out of retrieval indexes while retaining restorable archived documents.

cleanup_days_threshold.hint: Memories older than this many days become cleanup candidates. They will only be deleted if their importance is also below the threshold.

cleanup_importance_threshold.hint: Only memories with importance below this value will be cleaned up. 0.3 means memories below 30% importance.

memory_consolidation.hint: Periodically aggregate, organize, and summarize scattered low-value memories into more concise ones to control memory store size at the source

enabled.hint: When enabled, eligible scattered memories are automatically merged into concise summaries. Recommended when the memory store grows large.

trigger.hint: daily = run on the daily schedule; reflection = also check and run alongside each reflection.

granularity.hint: session = aggregate within the same session; semantic = cluster across sessions by semantic similarity.

keep_original.hint: archive = keep originals as archived (removed from retrieval but restorable); delete = remove originals permanently.

min_memories_per_group.hint: A group must contain at least this many memories to trigger consolidation, avoiding unnecessary LLM calls.

min_age_days.hint: Only consolidate memories older than this many days, avoiding recently-updated memories.

max_importance.hint: Only consolidate memories with importance below this value; high-importance memories stay untouched.

max_groups_per_run.hint: Limits how many groups are consolidated per run to avoid triggering too many LLM calls at once.

semantic_similarity_threshold.hint: In semantic mode, two memories are grouped only when their similarity reaches this value.
